records.q: For platform fire, upon receiving notification from the duty officer (operations), the duty station master immediately goes to the scene to confirm the situation. Organize nearby station attendants to use nearby fire extinguishers for initial firefighting. Report the on-site information to the station master, who immediately notifies the passenger transport center director. If the fire is controllable, organize the duty officer (passenger service) and cleaners to use caution tape to seal off the fire area, preventing unrelated personnel from entering. Organize station attendants to wear protective gear (firefighting suits) and rush to the scene to control the fire. Organize platform station attendants to maintain platform order and guide passengers to escalators and stairs away from the fire point. Organize the station attendant (customer service) at the fire area side concourse escalators and stairs to set up caution tape, maintain concourse order, and guide passengers to escalators and stairs away from the fire point. Notify the duty officer (operations) to report the on-site situation to the dispatcher and rail police. After extinguishing, cooperate with maintenance units to restore equipment and confirm that AFC, FAS, ACS, PA, PIS are normal, then report to the dispatcher after on-site confirmation. If the fire is uncontrollable, the duty station master confirms and presses the nearest manual alarm, organizes each post to execute station closure procedures, and reports to the dispatcher. Assign the security team leader to No. 1 entrance to guide 119 and 120 personnel to the rescue site. Assign cleaners to No. 1 and No. 2 entrances to intercept entering passengers, assign security to evacuate non-paid area passengers. Observe station AFC, FAS, ACS, PA, PIS equipment linkage and notify the duty officer (operations) promptly. After the fire brigade arrives, the volunteer fire team members report relevant information (such as contact rail electrification status) to the fire chief and hand over, cooperating with rescue. Count station personnel to ensure all arrive at No. 1 entrance, then assign platform station attendants and duty officer (passenger service) to close No. 2 entrance and post notices, providing passenger explanations. Based on dispatcher orders, organize station attendant (customer service) and duty officer (passenger service) to handle bus connections at Xinsheng Station bus connection point. After fire handling, confirm AFC, FAS, ACS, PA, PIS equipment normal, prepare for reopening, report to dispatcher, and upon approval, organize station to resume normal operations.

After extinguishing, cooperate with maintenance units to check and confirm ATS/HMI, AFC, FAS, ACS, PA, PIS equipment normal, then report to the dispatcher after on-site confirmation.
